title: Mark the work complete
intro: Share the finished work so your client can review it.
noteHint: Describe what you completed during the remote session.
noteOptionalHint: Add anything your client should know about the finished work.
hoursHint: Up to {cap} hours. Enter hours in half-hour steps.
earningsHint: Enter valid hours and receipt amounts to see what you'll earn.
earningsError: Couldn't update what you'll earn. Try again.
changed: This booking has changed. Reload the booking to see what you can do next.
submitted: The work was sent for approval.
approval: Your client has 72 hours to approve the work or report a problem. After that, the booking is approved automatically.

photos.label: Photos of the finished work
photos.hint: Add {minimum, plural, =0 {photos if helpful} one {at least # photo} other {at least # photos}}, up to {maximum}. JPEG, PNG, WebP or HEIC, up to {megabytes} MB each. Avoid house numbers, mail, and people.
photos.required: Add {minimum, plural, one {at least # photo} other {at least # photos}} of the finished work.
photos.invalid: Check the photos and try again. You can add up to {maximum}.

errors.too_large: This photo is too large. Choose one under {megabytes} MB.
errors.unsupported_type: Choose a JPEG, PNG, WebP or HEIC photo.
errors.too_many: You can add up to {maximum, plural, one {# photo} other {# photos}}. Remove one to add another.
errors.rate_limited: Too many uploads at once. Wait a moment, then try again.
errors.unknown: The photo couldn't upload. Try again.

expenses.title: Receipts
expenses.hint: Add a receipt for each expense, up to {maximum, plural, one {# receipt} other {# receipts}}. Leave this empty if you didn't spend any of the allowance.
expenses.descriptionHint: Use 2 to 80 characters to describe the expense.
expenses.amountHint: Enter the amount shown on the receipt, such as 8.00.
expenses.photoHint: Add one clear receipt photo, up to {megabytes} MB.
expenses.overAllowance: The receipts exceed the {allowance} allowance. Check the amounts before sending.

unavailable.title: Completion isn't available
unavailable.already_submitted: You already sent the work for approval. View it on the booking page.
unavailable.not_started: Check in on the booking page before marking the work complete.
unavailable.closed: This booking is closed or has a reported problem. View the booking for the next step.

checklist.title: Checklist
checklist.hint: Optional. Tick what you did so your client can approve quickly; leave anything that didn’t apply.
